# Synthetic governed prose corpus

These six public, invented scenarios are source inputs for the headless document lab. The author-defined scenario facts are the truth for this exercise. They do not assert facts about real people, organizations, systems, contracts, or incidents. Fact status is explicit in both `kind` and non-observed fact text. A draft term is a proposal, never a binding agreement.

Each document fixture fixes its type, total output word range, purpose, fact ledger, section instructions, required goals, and independent negative seeds. `fact_ids` is the section's available source set; `required_fact_ids` marks facts that the section must cover. The acceptance methods require an independent semantic reviewer. The fixture does not award acceptance from model citations, claimed confidence, or shape checks alone.

`manifest.json` fixes 36 cells: six documents, executive and technical audiences, and three repeats each. Every planned cell, including a held, invalid, refused, or missing response, remains in the denominator. The negative cases also remain visible if a model or checker holds them. The case `expected: hold` means the mutated assertion should be refused under the listed criteria. Negative seeds test wrong valid citations, altered details, causal overreach, conflicts, factual text in structural elements, and unsupported authority. They are independent of generated output.

This corpus fixes inputs and oracles for a study. It is not runtime, quality, provider, or accuracy proof. The owner must freeze its exact bytes and adjudication rubric by digest before dispatch, then retain all attempted outputs and independent review findings.

## Independent pre-freeze review

The owner corrected three authored-oracle defects before any document provider
call: the agreement now consistently permits up to40 files, all demanded terms
have required fact IDs, and the long technical document is a review of a proposed
pilot rather than a complete implementation specification. Added explicitly
proposed technical detail supplies enough source material for the long format.
Canonical retry content, conflict diagnostics and success receipts are distinct.

Every fact has an authored `occurred_at` in the fictional scenario. These are
synthetic world timestamps, not inferred dates or actual API execution times.
Acquisition and observation use actual run time. The incident timeline and dated
runbook trial retain their authored dates across repeat executions.

The document capture path evaluates positive generation cells only. Negative
assertions are frozen available fixtures, not executed or passed results. A
separate bound assessment and its attempt denominator are required before any
negative-hold or HP-A14 claim. The corpus is not yet a completed qualification.
